message.content:
This image shows a magazine cover with the large red word "TEMPO" across the top. Below the title, a caricature of a man is depicted. He has a disproportionately large head, short black hair, and an open-mouthed expression. He wears a red baseball cap backwards, a gray short-sleeved shirt, and green cargo-style shorts. He also has a purple band on his right wrist and a spiked black wristband with a silver chain on his left wrist. On his feet are blue-and-white sneakers with white laces.

The man is positioned in a crouching athletic pose, physically interacting with a small red bus as if it were a skateboard. His right foot rests on the roof of the bus, while his left hand grips the front edge. The red bus is angled diagonally upward towards the right, appearing to fly through white space.

The text at the top of the cover reads "Sulitnya Melacak Dana Siluman Partai" in white and yellow font on a red bar. To the left of the caricature, the text reads "Busway: Proyek 'Bonek' Sutiyoso" in red and black. Small black text below the title reads "EDISI 5-11 Januari 2004". A barcode and price are visible at the bottom.
